**Shellac releases by Dizzy Gillespie that include John Coltrane**

| Release (Shellac – 10 ”, 78 RPM) | Album / Single | Coltrane’s role | Track(s) written by Gillespie (per Discogs) |
|---------------------------------|----------------|-----------------|--------------------------------------------|
| **Coast To Coast / Oo‑la‑la** – Telefunken – 450 (France, 1952) | Single | Tenor saxophone (track A) | **“Oo‑la‑la”** – Written‑By Dizzy Gillespie (see Discogs page: “B Oo‑la‑la Written By – Gillespie ‑ Williams Acea”) |
| **Tin Tin Daeo / Birks Works** – Dee Gee – 3600 (US, 1951) | Single | Tenor saxophone (track A) | **“Tin Tin Daeo”** – Written‑By Dizzy Gillespie; **“Birks Works”** – Written‑By Dizzy Gillespie (see Discogs page: “A Tin Tin Daeo Written‑By – Dizzy Gillespie”; “B Birks Works Written‑By – Dizzy Gillespie”) |
| **Birks Works / Tin Tin Deo** – Jazz Selection – J.S. 4018 (Sweden, 1953) | 7‑inch or 10‑inch single | Tenor saxophone (track A) | **“Birks Works”** – Written‑By Dizzy Gillespie (see Discogs page: “A Birks Works Written‑By – Dizzy Gillespie”) |
| **Tally‑Ho / I Can’t Remember** – Telefunken – CL 839 (Germany, 1950) | Single | Tenor saxophone (track A) | **“Tally‑Ho”** – Written‑By Dizzy Gillespie (see Discogs page: “A Tally‑Ho Written‑By – Dizzy Gillespie”) |

These are the only shellac releases in Dizzy Gillespie’s Discogs catalogue that list **John Coltrane** as a performer and that contain at least one track with a writer credit to **Dizzy Gillespie**.

---

### List of tracks where Gillespie is credited as writer

1. **Oo‑la‑la** (Coast To Coast / Oo‑la‑la)  
2. **Tin Tin Daeo** (Tin Tin Daeo / Birks Works)  
3. **Birks Works** (Tin Tin Daeo / Birks Works)  
4. **Birks Works** (Birks Works / Tin Tin Deo) – *same title, different single*  
5. **Tally‑Ho** (Tally‑Ho / I Can’t Remember)

These five titles represent all the tracks written by Dizzy Gillespie found on shellac recordings that feature John Coltrane.
